description: Gestion territoriale des routes départementales is a dataset listed in Doubs DATA open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD25. Découpage du réseau routier départemental par STA et par EGR. Coverage: Doubs. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are egr. The portal shows 1,270 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-doubs-fr-portal.
